name: Faschingerhof
beschreibung: The Faschingerhof is an inn in a quiet hillside location in the Tiroler Unterland. The surroundings are characterized by hiking trails and agricultural land. The house has guest rooms with bathroom and balcony as well as a guest lounge with tiled stove. The kitchen offers traditional Tiroler dishes. The atmosphere is homely and informal. The guests are mainly hikers and skiers looking for peace and nature. The nearest ski area can be reached by car in ten minutes. Pets are allowed.
